If you are like me, you have definitely spent a lot of time going deeper and deeper into random articles on Wikipedia. Now there is finally an official app—uh, I mean a widget that can do it.

Finally, there is a button that can open a random Wikipedia article

The updated Wikipedia iOS app today has added a rather fun and practical new feature: a random article widget that can be placed on the home screen of iPhones and iPads.

The widget comes in two sizes (small and medium), and even includes a cute mascot.

Tap the widget and it will immediately jump to a completely random Wikipedia article, and automatically turn on random mode.

Without leaving the app and tapping the widget again, just press the random button and the virtual dice will roll out a new article for you, letting you go deeper and deeper randomly.

Enjoy it slowly, but remember not to lose track of time! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app also launched a history trivia quiz game.

You can find this new widget in the updated Wikipedia iPhone and iPad app today.

Let's unleash more potential of your Apple products together
